name: status
description: Status for the open 4D-planering 3D editor: project, coordinate origin, camera, active tool, selected object ids and object counts. Call this first. All coordinates in this API are the project's absolute coordinates in metres (z is height).

name: screenshot
description: Take a picture of the current 3D view. Use it after every change to check the result with your own eyes, and before deciding where to build.

width.description: Max image width in px (200-1600, default 1024)

name: list_objects
description: List the 3D objects in the editor (drawn bodies, library objects, models placed by the user). Returns id, type, name, position, size and bounding box (bbox min/max). Filter by name substring or type substring.

name: get_object
description: Details for one object: properties, points, shape and computed dimensions.

name: list_library
description: List the library objects that can be placed with place_library (scaffolds, cranes, site cabins, storage, fences, crews, deliveries ...), with default dimensions and the editable fields of smart objects.

name: list_site_items
description: List the site-plan ('etablering') items on the 2D plan that also show in 3D: fence, route, scaffold, barrier, shed, storage, gate, crane, note, symbol.

name: create_box
description: Create a solid box. x,y is the centre of the footprint, z the bottom, length along X, width along Y, height up (metres). rot = degrees around Z.

name: create_prism
description: Create a solid by extruding a polygon straight up. points = footprint corners [[x,y],...] (min 3), z = bottom level, height = extrusion height (metres).

name: create_cylinder
description: Create a solid cylinder standing on z. x,y = centre.

name: create_polyline
description: Draw a 3D line through points [[x,y,z],...].

name: place_library
description: Place a library object (see list_library), e.g. type 'sm:stallningfri' (scaffold), 'tornkran', 'lada'. x,y,z = position, rot in degrees. Optional L,B,H,R overrides, 'fields' for smart-object fields, and 'points' for path objects such as fences.

name: add_site_item
description: Add a site-plan item (shown in 2D and 3D). type: fence/route/scaffold/barrier (polyline or polygon points [[x,y],...]), shed/storage (two opposite corners), gate/crane/note/symbol (one point). Scaffold props: w (width m), h (height m), fack (bay width m), lifts, name, wid = widenings/platforms [{i: segment index from 0, a: from m along segment, b: to m, d: extension m, s: 1 or -1 side}]. Scaffold lines should be drawn straight (multiples of 5 degrees) along the facade.

name: update_site_item
description: Change a site-plan item: props (same keys as add_site_item) and/or new points.

name: delete_site_item
description: Delete a site-plan item (undoable in the editor).

name: update_object
description: Change a 3D object: name, color, move to x/y/z (any subset), rot (degrees), size L/B/H/R for library objects, fields for smart objects.

name: duplicate_object
description: Copy an object. With dx,dy (metres) the copy is moved by that offset, otherwise it is placed next to the original.

name: delete_objects
description: Delete 3D objects by id (undoable with the undo tool).

name: select
description: Select objects in the editor (highlights them for the user).

name: fly_to
description: Move the camera to an object (id) or a point [x,y,z]. top=true looks straight down.

name: set_camera
description: Set the camera position and target in project coordinates.

name: undo
description: Undo the last change in the editor (the same as Ctrl+Z).

name: redo
description: Redo.

name: eval_js
description: Last resort: run JavaScript inside the editor (variables l3, THREE, placements are in scope; return a JSON value). The user must approve every call in the browser. Prefer the other tools.

name: push_pull
description: Push/Pull (like SketchUp): extrude a drawn face into a solid, or change the height of a solid. distance in metres: positive = up/out along the normal, negative = down. For a solid, distance is added to its height.

name: offset_outline
description: Offset the outline of a drawn horizontal face/solid: positive grows it outward, negative shrinks it inward (metres). Good for wall thickness, margins, plinths.

name: transform_object
description: Move/rotate/scale/mirror an object. move=[dx,dy,dz] metres; rotate=degrees (added to current rotation); scale = number or [sx,sy,sz] (drawn horizontal solids only); mirror='x' or 'y' (drawn horizontal solids only).

name: array_copy
description: Make N copies spaced by (dx,dy,dz) metres each step, e.g. a row of columns or formwork elements.

name: create_wall
description: Create a wall along a polyline (centre line points [[x,y],...]) with thickness and height (metres). Corners are mitred. closed=true makes a closed room wall with an open interior (needs >= 3 points).

name: create_gable_roof
description: Create a gable roof. x,y = centre of the roof footprint, z = eaves level. length = along the ridge (X), width = across (Y), rise = ridge height above eaves, overhang optional. rot = degrees around Z.

name: create_stairs
description: Create a straight stair. x,y = start of the bottom step (centre of width), z = bottom level; steps, rise (riser height m, default 0.175), run (tread depth m, default 0.28), width (m). Climbs along +X; rot = degrees around Z.

name: measure
description: Distance between two points [x,y,z]: straight, horizontal and vertical.

name: set_view_mode
description: Viewer display mode: shaded, wire, xray or real (realistic lighting with shadows).

name: set_sun
description: Set the sun for shadows: azimuth in degrees from north clockwise (90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west), elevation 1-89 degrees above the horizon.

name: render_image
description: Render a high-quality still of the current view with the built-in render engine: progressive accumulation gives anti-aliasing, soft sun shadows and ambient occlusion from the sky, ACES tone mapping. quality: fast (12 passes), good (48), best (160) or samples=1-512. width up to 2048 (default 1280). Slower than screenshot (seconds) but looks much better; use it for presentation images after the model is finished. Camera = current view (use fly_to/set_camera first).

edges.description: keep the dark CAD outlines on solids (default false)

background.description: sky gradient (default) or the editor's own background

use_render_materials.description: apply the stored render materials, ground and environment (default true)

depth_of_field.description: Depth-of-field blur amount 0-10 (0 = everything sharp). Focus = the point the camera looks at, or focus_distance

focus_distance.description: Focus distance in metres for depth_of_field

name: list_render_materials
description: List the render material library (about 50 PBR materials: ground, concrete, masonry, wood, metal, glass & water, plaster/paint/roofing) with real tile size in metres, roughness, metalness and opacity. These materials are used ONLY by render_image – the editor's own look is never changed. Filter by group name.

name: get_render_setup
description: Current render setup stored in the project: material rules, ground material and areas, environment; plus the IFC classes and colours present in the scene that you can target.

name: set_render_material
description: Give objects a render material (like Twinmotion: pick target, pick material). Targets: object_id / object_ids (drawn or placed 3D objects), ifc_class (e.g. IFCWALL, IFCSLAB: all elements of that class in all IFC models), ifc_guid, or color (hex of the original colour, e.g. '#a8b3c4': everything with that colour). Priority: object > ifc_guid/ifc_class > color. scale multiplies the tile size, rotation in degrees, tint a hex colour multiplied onto the material. Only affects render_image.

name: remove_render_material
description: Remove a render material rule (by the same target as set_render_material, rule_id, or all=true).

name: set_ground_material
description: Set the base ground material for renders (a large ground plane that receives shadows and replaces the plan drawing in the image). material omitted/null removes it. z = ground level in project coordinates (default: the plan's level).

name: add_ground_area
description: Add a ground area or road with its own material on top of the base ground. kind 'area' = polygon points [[x,y],...]; kind 'road' = centre line points with width (m). Or use from_object_id with a drawn face/solid (area) or drawn line (road) – the source object is then hidden in renders unless hide_source=false.

name: remove_ground_area
description: Remove a ground area/road by id.

name: set_render_environment
description: Render environment: time of day (morgon/formiddag/dag/eftermiddag/kvall) or sun_azimuth/sun_elevation (degrees; azimuth from north clockwise), clouds 0-1 (softer, weaker sun, greyer sky), haze 0-1 (distance fog), exposure 0.5-2. Stored in the project; used by render_image.

name: render_film_start
description: Render a film of the project's day-by-day progress frame by frame with the render engine (soft shadows, AO, tone mapping), using the film settings (camera keys, interval) of the 3D view. Runs in the background; poll render_film_status. Output WebM (VP9) via WebCodecs or a JPEG-sequence ZIP; saved as a download in the browser when done. The view is restored afterwards. from/to = YYYY-MM-DD (default: saved film interval), seconds 1-600, fps 24/25/30/60, height = 480-2160 (16:9), samples = 1-64 per frame.

name: render_film_status
description: Progress of the film started with render_film_start: running, frame/frames, result (name, frames, format, size_mb, seconds, stopped) or error.

name: render_film_stop
description: Stop the running render film; frames already rendered are saved.

name: animate_object
description: Animate a placed object on the film timeline with keyframes (position, rotation, height offset, visibility, and WORK for machines). Machines to place with place_library: mach:crane, mach:excavator, mach:truck, mach:loader, mach:human (animated models from the walk mode: wheels roll while driving, boom/arm/bed move while work=true). Between keys the object moves smoothly; work=true from a key onward lets the machine work (smoothly blended). x,y in model coordinates. follow_path turns the object along its direction of travel. The animation is played in the film and in render_film_start. clear=true removes the keys.
